title: The '101' detector, clock by clock
statement: The figure's Moore machine watches its input $x$ for the sequence $1, 0, 1$, overlaps included. Its output $z$ is $1$ only in $S_3$, the double circle. With the codes $S_0 = 00$, $S_1 = 01$, $S_2 = 10$ and $S_3 = 11$ on $Q_1 Q_0$, its next-state equations are $D_1 = Q_0 x' + Q_1 Q_0' x$ and $D_0 = x$, and $z = Q_1 Q_0$. Starting in $S_0$, trace it period by period on the inputs below: the state, its code and $z$.
given: the states $S_0$ to $S_3$, starting in $S_0$ at reset

artefact.caption: Each clock period: the input, the state, its code and the output

steps.title: Read the machine
steps.note: $S_0$ is the reset state. A $1$ takes $S_0$ to $S_1$, a $0$ then takes $S_1$ to $S_2$, and a $1$ takes $S_2$ to $S_3$, the double circle where $z = 1$.

steps.title: Periods 1 to 3
steps.note: The $0$ in period $1$ keeps $S_0$; the $1$ in period $2$ is the first $1$ of the pattern, so period $3$ is in $S_1$.

steps.title: Periods 4 and 5
steps.note: The $1$ in period $3$ keeps $S_1$; the $0$ in period $4$ takes it to $S_2$, so period $5$ is in $S_2$.

steps.title: Period 6: 101 seen
steps.note: The $1$ in period $5$ takes $S_2$ to $S_3$. $z$ rises a period after the last $1$, since a Moore output belongs to the state.

steps.title: Periods 7 to 9: the overlap
steps.note: From $S_3$ a $0$ goes to $S_2$ and a $1$ then goes back to $S_3$: the $1$ of period $5$ serves both patterns, so $z$ rises again in period $8$.

answer: $z = 1$ in periods $6$ and $8$: after the $1, 0, 1$ of periods $3$ to $5$, and again after periods $5$ to $7$, which share the $1$ of period $5$.
